address: 328 Yaowarat Road, Chakkrawat, Samphanthawong, Bangkok, 10100, Thailand
bio: Housed in a five-storey Art Deco building, this eatery pays homage to its goldsmith heritage through its design. Chef David Thompson has been garnering acclaim for his Chinese cuisine with Thai touches since opening in 2023. High-quality ingredients that elevate tradition go into his refined yet honest food. Start with the crispy prawn wafer, and don't miss the roasted duck soup… but save room for the ginger milk curd – as simple as it is delightful....
